description: React component for a demo energy management dashboard with mock data, CSV parsing, anomaly detection, and visualization.

methods.name: parseCSV
methods.description: Parses CSV text into structured time-series data with rolling baseline computation.

methods.name: computeRollingBaseline
methods.description: Calculates a 4-week rolling average baseline for data points missing baseline values.

methods.name: buildMockSeries
methods.description: Generates mock hourly energy consumption data over 60 days with anomalies.

methods.name: aggregateData
methods.description: Aggregates time-series data into daily, weekly, or monthly summaries based on view mode.

methods.name: toPolylinePoints
methods.description: Converts data points into SVG polyline coordinate string for chart rendering.

methods.name: buildScales
methods.description: Creates x and y scale functions for SVG chart axes.

methods.name: computeAnomalies
methods.description: Detects anomalies based on deviation from baseline exceeding threshold percentage.

methods.name: buildAlerts
methods.description: Generates alert objects for detected anomalies and system info.

methods.name: formatKw
methods.description: Formats a numeric value as kilowatts string.

methods.name: severityLabel
methods.description: Returns label string for severity levels.
